name: MoYu WeiLong Ferrocore UV 3x3 (Special Edition WRM V10)
description: Here by popular demand! The MoYu WeiLong Ferrocore UV 3x3, a collaboration with CubeHead, is the newest evolution of the Ferrocore line. This cube is outfitted with metal parts connecting the core with the center and custom magnets and springs. This version of the Ferrocore comes with grey internals and a shiny UV coating on the exterior to aid with grip.
